title: A re-run after a landed vote skips the vote (and its deposit) and warns on a changed vote
notes: 0.33.0 vote-leg idempotency. dexe_proposal_create auto-votes with the creator's power, so the proposal is already voted by P the moment it exists. Step 2 re-votes in the SAME direction and must return voteAlreadyCast with the deposit step skipped (the deposit exists only to fund a vote that will not be sent); step 3 asks for the OPPOSITE direction and must additionally carry voteChangeAdvisory with the '⚠ HARM WARNING' cancel-then-revote text. Neither step 2 nor step 3 may broadcast. The guards are RETURNED FIELDS, not throws — a regression would show up as a successful second vote, which is exactly why these are `present`/`contains` assertions and not expectError. Requires the proposal to still be in Voting when steps 2-3 run: the fixture DAO needs durationSeconds >= 3600 and P must hold less than quorum (voteAmount '1.0') so earlyCompletion does not close it.
